svg.aria-label: Case file: Corvania, a fictional country. Question: should we approve Kestrel Mining’s new lithium mine on the Tavi River? Population: 6 million in 1980, 12 million in 2000, 19 million in 2024; births per woman 6.4 to 2.9; deaths per 1,000 people 18 to 7. Economy and emissions: GDP per person three times higher since 2000; cars per 1,000 people 40 in 2000 and 210 in 2024; 68% of electricity from coal; total CO2 2.6 times higher since 2000; CO2 per dollar of GDP down 20%. Kestrel Mining: the largest company, lithium; record profit 2.1 billion dollars; 4,000 workers; 9% of the government’s tax income; a map of the river with the old mine, the new mine 2 km away and 30 villages; dead fish on the Tavi River below the old mine in 2023; the new mine would add 1,200 jobs, upstream, 2 km from the river.
